release_notes:
2.0.2 — admin/client bug fixes

- Manage IMEI/Server Services: the Service Category filter now lists only categories that have at least one active service and repopulates by the selected Supplier API; category names display decoded (e.g. AT&T).
- Client Change Password: now confirms the change with a 6-digit code emailed to the registered address (10-minute expiry, attempt cap, resend); the new password must include a letter, a number, and a special character; on success all other trusted devices are signed out and a confirmation email is sent. Restyled to match the panel with a How-it-works panel.
- Server services: changing a server service's price now triggers the client price-change popup (previously only IMEI services did), and only when the price actually changes.
- Fixed a PHP 8 error in convertDate() that aborted the user overview page before its scripts loaded, which had left the Prices & Services dropdown and the tabs unresponsive on first load.
